summary: Reconcile the checkout layout: producer-side slimming of live records, evidence homes for vendor captures and paper notes, code out of results/, a package hierarchy in waves, and the owner decisions on bulk retention.

reconciliation.note: Every quantity in the design document is measured at a1d1743 with git ls-files, git count-objects, ci/gates.json, an import-graph scan of gororoba_quantum (two 14-module strongly connected components; 334 cross-package edges against 183 intra for the first draft's five-way cut) and the run directories. Peer reviews by Codex gpt-daybreak-blue-latest and Grok Build on 2026-10-30 were checked line by line; both refuted the first draft's private-repository move, timestamp-search age-out and prefix-based package cut, and the document records the refutations.

scope: Checkout layout of this repository: results/live producers (circuit archive store, allocation-search sidecar), docs homes (paper notes, vendor captures, design prose in the code directory, one documentation map), code out of results/, a gororoba_quantum package hierarchy in five waves, scripts grouped by provider, caches and object store outside the checkout. Retained bytes keep their paths until every binding is rebound in the same change. Deletion or relocation of the a5 working bundle and of unreferenced dry runs waits for the owner's decision recorded in the design document.
next_action: Owner answers the three decisions in docs/design/repository-layout-reconciliation.md (public data repository and size threshold, age-out window or none, interface extraction before directory moves); the cache, sparse-profile, archive-store and sidecar items proceed meanwhile.

steps.action: ci/pinned_tool.py keys the mypy cache under ${XDG_CACHE_HOME:-$HOME/.cache}/gororoba-quantum/mypy/; the canonical checkout registers git maintenance; pr.yml's stale 18 MiB comment names the measured pack
steps.acceptance: a gate run leaves no .mypy_cache in the checkout; git count-objects -v reports a loose count under gc.auto after a day of commits

steps.action: documented non-cone sparse-checkout profiles per worktree (code, documentation, evidence review, full audit); the link checker and ci/gate_inputs.py test the skip-worktree bit and hydrate or fail naming the path; pr.yml checks out with filter blob:none and the code profile
steps.acceptance: a code-profile worktree is under 1 GB; run_gates.py --affected-by reports a gate whose inputs are excluded; the link checker count matches a full worktree; pr.yml lint checkout time is recorded before and after

steps.action: the retention audit becomes the digest-bound ledger of promoted runs (cased, approved, collected, cited); run state is read from it, never from a text search; an age-out job with tombstones exists only if the owner sets a window
steps.acceptance: the ledger lists every collected and cited run at a1d1743; the age-out dry run names the 16 unpromoted directories and no other

steps.action: live_run.py writes each compiled archive once under results/live/archives/<sha256>.qpy; one verifying archive API (legacy isa.qpy first, then digest, bytes checked for every run) serves the 48 readers; the same shape covers the IQM metrics.json, Quandela, Kaggle and circuit.json duplicate groups
steps.acceptance: a dry run of an existing case writes no isa.qpy in its directory; adjudicate.py on a retained run reads its original bytes; every gate binding a retained run passes

steps.action: the planner writes allocation_search.candidates to allocation-search.json beside the record
steps.acceptance: a dry run of the ripple atlas case writes a record under 2 MB and the planning contracts read the candidates from the sidecar

steps.action: a documented size-and-access threshold; bundles above it go to a public data repository pinned by commit and sha256 manifest and are hydrated by the gates that reach them; frozen milestones get a Zenodo deposit with a BagIt manifest; existing history stays
steps.acceptance: the manifest verifier rejects a bundle whose bytes differ; a gate reaching an external bundle hydrates and passes on a hosted runner inside its budget

steps.action: the 22 identifier-named notes under docs/notes/ move to docs/notes/papers/ with their SOURCES.json note fields and inbound links
steps.acceptance: docs/verify_sources.py, the sources suite and scripts/check_markdown_links.py pass

steps.action: manifest-bound capture trees move from docs/notes/<provider>/ to docs/captures/<provider>/ with their scripts, gates and README tables
steps.acceptance: every capture --check passes offline and docs/notes/ holds about 500 Markdown files

steps.action: the thirteen Markdown documents in gororoba_quantum/ move to docs/design/ or docs/notes/topics/ with their map rows
steps.acceptance: the link checker passes and gororoba_quantum/ holds Python, its agent guide and requirements

steps.action: the Python files and case and findings documents under results/live/ move to scripts/, tests/ and docs/evidence/ibm-live-cases/ with their gates rewritten
steps.acceptance: ci/run_gates.py --affected-by reaches every rewritten gate and each passes

steps.action: four entry documents (AGENTS.md, docs/README.md, docs/INDEX.md, docs/state/plans.md); INDEX.md keeps only the source index; a map check enforces one parent entry per authored document and a hub allowlist for targets shared by the maps
steps.acceptance: the map check reports zero duplicate non-hub targets and zero orphaned authored documents

steps.action: gororoba_quantum/__init__.py with the directory kept on sys.path; the import-graph scan (edges, strongly connected components, private-symbol consumers) retained under docs/evidence/ and regenerated by a gate
steps.acceptance: both import spellings resolve; the gate reproduces the scan byte for byte

steps.action: live_run.py yields record and archive I/O, Target snapshots, compilation and placement, planning and approval, submission and collection to interface modules, in the order the private-symbol consumers point to, and stays the CLI facade; an import-boundary test rejects reverse edges
steps.acceptance: a byte-identical dry run of a retained case per extraction; every gate with cwd gororoba_quantum the diff reaches passes; the boundary test passes

steps.action: a cluster moves into a subpackage only when it has no edge into a strongly connected component, one per pull request, with gates and scripts rewritten in the same change
steps.acceptance: per move: mypy over the five code roots, the tests check, the reached gates and a live_run.py dry run

steps.action: scripts/ gains provider directories for the qi, ascella and qd, iqm and n21 clusters with package imports replacing sys.path insertion
steps.acceptance: ci/seed_provenance.py scans the new paths and the gates naming each script pass

steps.action: the owner decides the public data repository and size threshold, the age-out window or its absence, and the order of the package work
steps.acceptance: the three answers are recorded in the design document and the dependent steps carry them
